verdict.rationale: EDD's own e-Services for Business pages state that employers can register a payroll tax account, file returns and reports, and make payroll tax payments online. The guidance pages also document online enrollment and a no-enrollment payment option. missing for 10: hands-on or independent confirmation of completing a transaction end-to-end, because the transactional portal host was not fetched beyond its robots.txt.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: Register, close, or re-open an employer payroll tax account.
File, adjust, and print returns and reports.
Make payments including Payroll Tax Deposit (DE 88), account payments, and Earnings Withholding Order payments.
Make a payroll tax payment. No enrollment is necessary to use this service.
